intuition: Only the start of each consecutive run needs to count forward; all other values in that run can be skipped.

brute_force.approach: From every value, repeatedly check whether its successor exists and count the resulting run.

optimal.approach: Put values in a set and expand only when value - 1 is absent, so every run is traversed once.

edge_cases: An empty input has a longest run of length zero.
Duplicates do not lengthen a run because membership is tested in a set.
Negative values and runs crossing zero need no special handling.
